pitch:
Home Nail Studio, a new home-service nail design business in Cainta, Rizal.
A trained nail artist comes to your home with a sanitized kit and a gel lamp. No travel, no mall queue.
Signature gel nail design set (gel polish plus custom nail art on all 10 nails, you pick the design from our portfolio or send your own): ₱1,800 per person.
Free home service within Cainta; ₱150 transport fee to Taytay, Antipolo, Pasig and Marikina. Book on Facebook Messenger.
Weddings and events: we come to the venue or your home, design approved by photo before the day, and a free fix within 48 hours if a nail chips.
All prices are in Philippine pesos (₱).
